output.title: Deadline for sending the specialty intake packet to Harbor Specialty Pharmacy
output.draft_text:
Q: How long do I have to send the specialty intake packet?

A: Once the intake packet is finished, send it to Harbor Specialty Pharmacy before the end of the same business day (source: U-KNOWN-FACT).

- The end of the business day means [cutoff time and time zone].
- Send the packet by [submission method, such as fax, portal, or secure email] to [Harbor Specialty Pharmacy contact or destination].
- If the packet is finished on a non-business day, send it by [deadline for packets finished on weekends or holidays].
- If you cannot send the packet the same business day, [steps to take if the deadline is missed, including who to notify].
- The packet counts as finished when [definition of a finished intake packet or required components].
